description: Trigger eval queries for /maxpublish skill. Tests whether Claude recognizes when to consult the skill for multi-registry publish tasks.

evals.prompt: ok so I just merged the v2.0 release branch and I want to ship to npm + github release at the same time. can you walk me through it?
evals.expected_output: Claude invokes /maxpublish (or explains it would run signals.sh + hitl-html.sh on the project), identifies npm as a high-confidence auto-default, mentions gh-release as medium-confidence, and surfaces the single-page HITL flow.

evals.prompt: /maxpublish
evals.expected_output: Claude invokes the maxpublish skill explicitly.

evals.prompt: this is a Python package with a Dockerfile and I want to push it to PyPI and Docker Hub. what's the cleanest way?
evals.expected_output: Claude invokes /maxpublish and notes that pypi + docker are both high-confidence auto-defaults based on the manifests, so they'd be auto-published unless the user opts out via the HITL page.

evals.prompt: I made a VS Code extension. how do I get it on the marketplace? also want it on npm.
evals.expected_output: Claude invokes /maxpublish and notes that a package.json with engines.vscode triggers BOTH vsce and npm as high-confidence candidates.

evals.prompt: 发布 win-ontology 0.4 — npm + GitHub release + Docker
evals.expected_output: Claude invokes /maxpublish, runs signals.sh --guide, identifies 3 candidates (npm, docker, gh-release), and prepares the HITL page.

evals.prompt: is this project ready to release? what am I missing?
evals.expected_output: Claude invokes /maxpublish --eval to do a release-readiness audit, and points to the DoD in EVAL.md and the blocker detection in hitl-html.sh.

evals.prompt: I need to push a Firefox extension to AMO. can the skill do that?
evals.expected_output: Claude invokes /maxpublish and explains that manifest.json with browser_specific_settings.gecko → AMO (high-confidence), and OAuth dance is required (the skill lists the web-ext CLI but doesn't open a browser itself).

evals.prompt: 我刚把项目里所有 manifest 都 ready 了，发到所有能发的地方，token 缺哪些我自己去补
evals.expected_output: Claude invokes /maxpublish and explains the flow: signals detect candidates → hitl-html.sh opens with blockers + draft + 4 buttons → user fixes tokens in the HTML page → user clicks an action button → copy prompt back to Claude Code → Claude runs the parallel publishes.

evals.prompt: release v1.2.3 — bump version in all manifests, build, push to PyPI and crates.io
evals.expected_output: Claude invokes /maxpublish and notes that fix-version.sh handles the manifest bump, then publishes to pypi + cargo (both high-confidence).

evals.prompt: I want to publish my Chrome extension MV3 to Chrome Web Store AND Edge Add-ons. same zip right?
evals.expected_output: Claude invokes /maxpublish and explains that manifest.json (MV3, no gecko) → chrome-web-store; manifest.json with edge key → edge-addons. Both high-confidence. Zip can be reused.

evals.prompt: let's cut a release. npm + GitHub release + the Chrome Web Store. run /maxpublish.
evals.expected_output: Claude invokes /maxpublish.

evals.prompt: I added a new platform to the registry list. how do I extend /maxpublish?
evals.expected_output: Claude reads the skill and explains the 5-file change pattern (signals.sh, fix-install.sh, fix-credentials.sh, hitl-html.sh, REFERENCE.md, EVAL.md).

evals.prompt: how do I install npm on my Mac?
evals.expected_output: Claude gives a direct answer (brew install node, or nvm). Does NOT invoke /maxpublish — that's for publishing, not installing local tools.

evals.prompt: what's the difference between a docker container and a docker image?
evals.expected_output: Claude answers the conceptual question. Does NOT invoke /maxpublish — no publish intent.

evals.prompt: I'm using GitHub Actions to auto-publish my npm package on every tag. can you help me set up the workflow?
evals.expected_output: Claude helps with the CI workflow (actions/setup-node, npm publish with provenance, NODE_AUTH_TOKEN secret). Does NOT invoke /maxpublish — that's for local one-shot publishes; CI is its own beast (release-please, semantic-release, etc.).

evals.prompt: show me the README of this project
evals.expected_output: Claude reads the README. Does NOT invoke /maxpublish.

evals.prompt: I have a bug where my Chrome extension breaks when I refresh. help me debug it.
evals.expected_output: Claude debugs the extension. Does NOT invoke /maxpublish — that's for publishing, not debugging.

evals.prompt: what's the best Python web framework?
evals.expected_output: Claude answers the question. Does NOT invoke /maxpublish.

evals.prompt: can you write a regex that matches emails?
evals.expected_output: Claude writes the regex. Does NOT invoke /maxpublish.

evals.prompt: I want to add a new page to my docs site. can you help me write the markdown?
evals.expected_output: Claude writes the markdown. Does NOT invoke /maxpublish — no publish intent, just content.
